label: preserve lien by
basis: 60 days after the earliest applicable event: you last supplied services/materials (2026-03-20)

label: perfect lien by (commence action)
basis: 90 days after the last day the lien could have been preserved; ONLY if the lien was actually preserved first (s.36(1)); a preserved lien may instead be perfected by sheltering under another claimant's action (s.36(4))

label: publish notice of termination by
basis: owner or contractor must publish a notice of termination within 7 days; the termination date for s.31 is the date the first notice is published

label: events not supplied (could make it EARLIER)
